title: POST /tournaments/:id/rounds/:n/matches/:match/lineups/confirm request
description: Confirm one side's line-up of a team match (or both) as it stands on the boards: the Pairings page's 'Confirm <team>'. `a` is the first-named team, `b` the other. A side already confirmed stays as it was. Answered with round-response.schema.json (200), the round as it now is. Refusals (error.schema.json): 400 bad_request (no such side), 404 match_not_found (not a match of this round), 404 not_paired, 409 not_team_event, 422 bye_match, 409 archived / handed_off; 403 arbiter_role for an arbiter (the owner and editors only, as on the Pairings page) and 404 as for any desk route. Changing a line-up, and taking a confirmation back, stay at the desk.
